title: Membership in an Indexed Language
statement: Let $p$ be any predicate on pairs consisting of a binary string and a natural number. For every binary string $x$ and every $i\in\mathbb{N}$, the encoding of $x$ paired with the binary expansion of $i$ belongs to the language of encodings $\langle x',\operatorname{bits}(i')\rangle$ for which $p(x',i')$ holds if and only if $p(x,i)$ holds.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a predicate on binary strings and natural numbers
